notes: Ludum Dare 39 entry by team Mergers and Acupuncture (git author David Jerome). Complete Unity 2017.1.0f3 project (Assets+ProjectSettings) with a playable LevelGeneratorTest scene, 2D player motor (run/jump/fall), level generator, battery/key pickups, doors and falling-block obstacles, author-made sprites/FBX, and two WAV clips. Apache-2.0 (Copyright 2017 Mergers and Acupuncture, notice in LICENSE appendix). SNAPSHOT CHANGE: upstream vendored prime31/CharacterController2D (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, non-redistributable) was omitted and replaced with an original Apache-2.0 kinematic 2D mover of the same class name exposing isGrounded/velocity/move for PlayerMotor; PlayerMotor no longer imports the Prime31 namespace. Remainder of the tree is unchanged from the pin. No bundled fonts, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no DOTween, no EmojiOne, no LFS, no DLL/EXE. EditorBuildSettings has no listed scenes (editor-playable jam project). ~5.6M src snapshot.
